text:
laura_se: Heads up — Orpheus Analytics returned their RFI. Key asks: a concrete POC plan (scope + timeline + success metrics), confirmation about supporting their on-prem HSM (they listed UbiTrust HSM 5K), and a pricing outline for a 3-week reserved evaluation. They attached their security questionnaire and want per-route cost export during the eval.

laura_se: dropping their attachment in the thread.

assets_bot: Uploaded: orpheus_rfi_2026-04-12.pdf (2.7 MB)

tom_pricing: Quick Q: do we have a standard 3-week reserved eval SKU? If not, propose a band. Also need their expected peak tokens/day to firm numbers.

laura_se: They gave an initial traffic estimate: 800 reqs/hour peak, average prompt+gen ~600 tokens. I'll confirm a 1-hour trace.

nirmal_security: For UbiTrust HSM 5K — we support PKCS#11 remote wrapping patterns for several vendors, but we haven't validated that model specifically. We should ask the buyer for vendor firmware version and whether keys are extractable. If they insist keys never leave the HSM, we need Private deployment or a hosted KMS adapter with remote wrap.

erin_legal: If keys never leave their HSM we need a POC addendum that covers key custody and limits our liability. I'll draft a 1-page addendum: NDA extension + indemnity carveout + limited support SLA for HSM operations.

laura_se: Can you also confirm whether we can promise a per-route token breakdown in the POC report? They want it for internal chargeback.

tom_pricing: Hosted Console includes per-route token metrics and cost breakdowns — we can enable a read-only dashboard token during the POC. For Dedicated, we can export per-route costs but retention is shorter unless they buy the observability add-on. For Private, it depends on their telemetry collection config.

nirmal_security: Action item: attach our completed security questionnaire and mark HSM rows TBD until they confirm model/firmware.

laura_se: here's a proposed POC we can pitch:
- Duration: 3 weeks (21 days)
- Infra: 1 dedicated GPU-equivalent node (A10G class) in our Dedicated pool, warmed cache + prefix caching, with autoscaling disabled for test determinism
- Workload: buyer-supplied 1-hour trace to replicate peak QPS, latency suite, throughput ramp, and regression prompt set
- Success criteria:
  - p95 latency < 70ms for interactive prompts (can tighten to 50ms with auto-batching)
  - sustained throughput >= 500 tokens/sec for the peak window with <1.5% errors
  - semantic regression <4% on holdout prompts
- Deliverables: test harness + raw traces, cost breakdown per route, capability matrix mapping to their RFP rows, and a short one-page summary

laura_se: pricing band draft (ballpark, final after egress/HSM details):
- Hosted PAYG: standard token rates; estimate $0.018/token for generated tokens in heavy-gen flows (placeholder)
- 3-week Reserved Eval (Dedicated node): $10,500 flat + metered tokens
- Private on-prem: $42,000 one-time deploy + $6,000/month support retainer (minimum 3 months)

laura_se: include an option for an HSM support CLIN (contract line item) if they require on-site engineering or special key import procedures — estimate $6k for POC-level HSM integration labor.

nirmal_security: Checklist to send back with the RFI response:
- provide 1-hour traffic trace (timestamps + tokens)
- confirm HSM vendor, firmware, and whether remote wrap ok or keys must never leave HSM
- peering/VPN info (CIDRs, firewall rules) if they want VPC peering
- identity provider (SAML/SCIM) details for users in the POC
- list of compliance artifacts required (SOC2, ISO27001, PCI)

ops_bot: Uploaded: orpheus_network_cidrs.png

laura_se: I'll prepare the capability matrix mapping their rubric rows to our features (HSM compatibility, SOC2, latency SLOs, data residency). Tom, can you produce a single-slide pricing summary we can attach? Mark the HSM labor CLIN as optional.

tom_pricing: Yup — will draft two columns: POC discounted rate and enterprise reserved. I'll add notes about telemetry retention (Hosted: 90 days; Dedicated: 7 days by default; add-on extends to 90).

erin_legal: I'll get the POC addendum and HSM clause drafted by EOD tomorrow. Also recommend we request a mutual NDA if sensitive keys are involved.

laura_se: timeline: Orpheus wants kickoff in 8 business days. We can do it if we receive the trace + HSM confirmation in 3 business days and sign the addendum. Otherwise we ask to shift 1 week.

nirmal_security: Also add one more ask: confirm the base model family they expect in the POC (e.g., Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, etc.) and whether they expect 4-bit quantization. We need this to preselect kernels and QoS.

laura_se: I'll request model list. I'll also attach our security questionnaire response draft and mark HSM rows TBD.

assets_bot: Uploaded: orpheus_capability_matrix_draft.xlsx and orpheus_poc_onepager.pdf

laura_se: Nice. I'll send the RFI response with the matrix, pricing slide, the security questionnaire (with TBDs), and our POC checklist. Reopen if buyer pushes earlier dates. :thumbsup:
